properties.finite: only finitely many positive-integer/prime triples have npq<=N
properties.exhaustive: every finite-labelled edge lies in E_N for N>=npq
properties.reciprocal_closed: (n,p,q) and (n,q,p) enter at the same cutoff
properties.cycle_natural: boundary_M j_NM=i_NM boundary_N, hence cycles map to cycles
properties.greedy_natural: one global product-then-lexicographic order restricts to every E_N

history_continuity.uniformity: the constant delta^-1 is independent of N
history_continuity.conclusion: all finite history maps have one cutoff-independent q_delta bound and extend to C_exp(W_star)
